description: Budget for Zig tests that skip themselves, read by scripts/check-test-skips.ps1 (PKG-76, F207). allowedSkips lists the tests in the guarded family that may skip on that runner; a skip outside it fails, because a shaping or metrics test that stops running looks like green CI. maxTotalSkipped is the total across the whole suite. Lower a number when a skip goes away. Raise one only with the reason in the commit message.

windows-2022.comment: 2026-10-17: 77 measured in Server 2022 run 39076551334. The added skip is config.windows_shell.test.shell discovery accepts a real installed Store execution alias (#443): it requires a usable installed wt.exe or winget.exe Store alias. This optional installed-alias coverage is unavailable on this runner; it is not an explicit build-number gate. The nine font skips are unchanged. 2026-11-06: 80 measured in Server 2022 run 42269314099. The three added since run 40796984718 (77 on 2026-10-29) came with #638 and #635 on 2026-10-31 and skip by design, never seen here before because the suite failed first from 2026-11-02: os.local_path.test.link target: no text in the full sweep aborts or leaks (runs only with NOCTTY_RUN_LOCAL_PATH_SWEEP=1); terminal.kitty.graphics_image.test.image load: windows file path that is not drive-absolute is refused (needs the temporary directory on the current directory's drive, and the runner checks out on D:); terminal.search.pattern.test.forQuery rejects non-default options without oniguruma (the build has oniguruma).
